title: REPORT on the annual report on the activities of the European Ombudsman in 2024
part_text: 6. Stresses that the Commission should improve the rules on pesticides in order to better take into account all scientifically validated alternatives, including chemical and non-chemical solutions, while safeguarding agricultural productivity, food security and farmers’ competitiveness; calls on the Commission to ensure that the approval process is fully transparent and follows strict safeguards against conflicts of interest, duly taking into account the Ombudsman’s suggestions for improvement;
